designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale bone chitin, cool gray-beige recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe at thin shield rims and joints, dark desaturated cavities, moist highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth. Preserve readable value separation without the base red-black pigmentation, pure white or neon.
designDetails.surface: Keep the organic biomechanical ribs, shield rim, tendons, hip plates, tail segmentation and wet mouth readable. The albino surface is newly authored; toy hinges, copied licensed pixels, filtering and automatic recolor artifacts are prohibited.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless shielded head with double jaw, one narrow ribbed torso, exactly two muscular forelegs, two digitigrade hind legs and one continuous thick tail with one flattened spear blade. No equipment.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; shield, four limbs, jaws, hip points, entire tail and tail blade stay inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Use the reviewed Prowler body plan and ribcage-to-shield proportions as anatomical guidance only. The base metadata records a historical final pack scale of 0.539759036, but scaleCalibrationReview is null and scaleCalibrationEvidence is empty; no per-clip numeric calibration is inherited. The new 067 sources require a complete independent all-clip scale review before acceptance.
designDetails.root: Track the center of the ribcage immediately behind the front shoulder and project it to the actual planted support plane. For pounce flight, preserve authored vertical displacement and separately review takeoff, airborne and landing support planes; tail tip, shield edge and reach never define the physical root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text, logo or grid.
